The $100 = edition credit in $17/mo plan (7-day trial requires card).

So user signed up and saw no credit — correct, because there's no $100 free credit. Free = 50 req/day.

Now: how to get API key? Dashboard /dashboard#keys after email signup. User said "gk ada kok" — maybe they can't find key or no free shown.

Let me give clear answer:
- Free = 50 API req/day + 20 chat/day, only during 16:00–20:00 Madrid (22:00–02:00 WIB)
- No $100 free credit (I was wrong; $100 is edition credit in paid plan)
- API key at Dashboard → Keys after email signup
- Base URL: https://api.lebrel.ai/v1 (chat completions) or attested.lebrel.ai/v1 (responses/Codex)

Let me update AKSES.md to correct the error, and answer.
